initial.menu:
Use case: ui-mockup. This is an ORIGINAL, high-fidelity 16:9 PC game UI art-direction mockup for the existing game DontEraseMe, a top-down survivors-like game about expressive ink marks resisting hostile erasers. Output a single complete landscape game screen, target 2048x1152, edge to edge, no monitor/device/browser frame. 
Input image 1 is ONLY a style reference for distressed charcoal paper, warm ivory drawing, restrained rusty red accents and simple hand-drawn HUD. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for a rough chalk/pen-on-dark-paper menu layout. Do NOT reproduce their watermarks, text errors, fake stats or character silhouettes. Reinterpret, not copy.
Visual direction: raw monochrome pen-and-ink survival game, rough printed indie comic, dark ballpoint-pencil sketch aesthetic. Deep charcoal-grey paper #292b27, grey graphite #55564f, warm bone ink #e4ddc3, sparse oxide-red #a54b3f for danger and active states. Subtle paper fibers, faint fold, short dry-brush breaks, rubbed-away marks. A few clear flat tones and strong economical linework; hand-drawn but controlled and competent, NOT childish. Hand-lettered/stencilled headings, readable compact Chinese sans UI body. Matte and tactile. No polished elegant luxury UI, no gold/brass, no medieval ornament/runes, no ornate serif typography, no glass UI, no candy colors, no neon, no large white panels, no photorealism or 3D render, no conventional shiny RPG menu. Small warm light lines are fine, NOT thick white outlines around every element. NO watermarks.
Character design language: original compact 2.5-head-tall fighters with simple heads, very sparse face lines, sharply angled expressive brows and narrow watchful eyes, clear mouth and strong asymmetrical stance. Short sturdy bodies, bold hands/boots, strong black silhouette breaks. Confident, weary, defiant personality with very few lines; NOT a realistic anime adult, faceless white silhouette, cute mascot, toddler, slime, skull hero, or heavily detailed armored knight. Do not copy any existing game's named character. The collector carries a chunky drawing brush as a weapon.
Asset: MAIN MENU concept only, not in-game HUD.
Composition: title at upper left, hand-drawn central illustration occupying the middle-left ~55% of screen, vertical menu on right ~28%. Background softly sketched battered courtyard floor fading into rough paper, a fragment of broken facade/fence at lower left; faint interrupted drafting lines, not a busy full-screen grid. One original collector faces right in a grounded determined ready pose, about 26% of image height, holds a large battered brush diagonally; dark clothing and a bone-colored angular face with a simple square pair of glasses, assertive eyes rather than smiling. Several ragged ink strokes spread behind him, one edge visibly rubbed away into paper dust by the pressure of erasure. Only 2 small angular eraser enemies, lower-left edge, looking severe; this is illustrative atmosphere, not a giant battle poster. Plenty of breathing room around UI. No central glowing magical orb.
Typography exact: upper-left title "DON'T ERASE ME", in robust rough uppercase ink lettering over two lines, with visibly scraped interruption through a small part of ERASE but still fully readable. Small subline "笔迹与擦除". On right four generously separated rough thin ivory-outlined rectangular menu options exactly "创造模式", "守卫模式", "纯画画模式", "我的画廊". First option indicated by one small rust-red triangle and a dry red underline, not a large red filled button. Footer small secondary text controls exactly "设置" and "退出游戏"; small subtle "WASD 移动 · 鼠标瞄准 · ESC 暂停" at bottom-left. Keep ALL text within safe margins, sharp Chinese text, exact spelling, no extra slogans, invented chapter numbers, fake progress, or bogus statuses. This must feel like an actual game title screen, NOT a website or an elegant book cover.

Asset: ACTUAL GAMEPLAY-STYLE COMBAT SCREEN with compact HUD, design concept only. This is the same game and same coherent art language as a main-menu companion. Not a montage, poster, card selection or big hero portrait.
Scene: overhead 2D survival battle with an open dark-grey sketchbook courtyard occupying 75% of the view, slightly oblique top-down pen-drawn environmental geometry. Irregular fragments of ruined shop walls, broken fence, sparse bare trees and rubble hug ONLY the outer 12% edges, very low-contrast graphite so the playable center stays clear. No big grid across battlefield, no paper-white floor. A recognizable arena with ground contact shadows, sparse paving marks and rubbing scars.
Subject: original collector at center, FULL BODY about 6% of screen height, small but readable, cream angular face with a few lines and square glasses, narrowed determined eyes, short dark coat and sturdy boots, both hands controlling a thick brush pointed right. Strong forward braced action pose. 12–16 tiny hostile anthropomorphic ERASERS on the surrounding battlefield, NOT skulls or zombies: chipped rectangular or beveled eraser blocks, sparse dark scowls, short simple legs, angular intimidating silhouettes, ivory-grey bodies with rusty-red worn cap accents; variety in silhouette but few details. Maintain clear gaps around hero. Dry ivory ink projectile dashes and a restrained warm rusty-red brush trail curve across the ground, one eraser rubs away a short section into pale crumbs. Effects readable and sparse, not a solid paint explosion.
HUD occupies under 15% screen area, clean practical text and small icons, all near screen edges. Upper-left small open-line panel, NOT large paper card: exact "生命 640 / 800", thin muted rust-red health bar, "Lv. 7" and a thinner ivory XP bar; below it a SMALL etched brush icon beside "基础画笔 8 / 12" and 12 tiny ammo ticks. Beneath in tiny legible text "得分 350 · 金币 42 · 评级 180". Upper-right a compact roughly squared inset minimap, only ~9% of screen width with a thin broken ivory chalk border; dark map fill, simple irregular light outline, a small ivory player marker and 5 rusty-red enemy dots. Small pause mark beside it. Bottom-center just ONE compact G-key meter labeled exactly "G  神笔 32 / 45" with a simple original nib icon and restrained half-filled ivory bar. No giant inventory, NO 4-button hotbar, NO invented armor/erasure resistance/mana/stamina, NO countdown for this creative combat mode, NO offscreen numbered callout circles/diagonal diagrams. UI text should be understated, legible at game scale. The battlefield, not HUD, is the focal point.

refinement.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup. Edit this existing ORIGINAL main menu mockup only for visual simplicity. KEEP exactly its 16:9 layout, charcoal rough-paper/ivory/rust-red palette, all UI text and exact legible menu labels "创造模式", "守卫模式", "纯画画模式", "我的画廊", "设置", "退出游戏", and title "DON'T ERASE ME"; keep the same glasses-wearing collector identity, expression, brush-wielding stance and menu alignment. Crucial correction: make the character and environment MUCH SIMPLER, like economical old hand-drawn 2D action-game sprites rather than richly illustrated anime. Remove 70% of tiny garment seams, wrapped grips, folds, hair strands, rubble chips and crosshatching. Head: one compact solid black hair shape with three blunt tufts, rectangular glasses, two sharp determined eyebrow/eye marks, one short stern mouth stroke. No elaborate anime bangs, cute blush or baby face. Body: dark jacket depicted with just 2 large angular flat charcoal shapes, one rust-red scarf shape, chunky plain gloves and boots, few confident contours. Keep character posture powerful and distinctive. Environmental buildings reduced to large graphite blocks with sparse broken line contours, much softer and lower contrast; remove most distracting white debris around the character. Preserve ONE strong cream/rust dry-brush sweep. Preserve subtle charcoal paper texture. Flatten illustration into 4-5 simple matte tonal masses, while retaining good readable silhouettes. UI typography stays clean, wear is only at edges. No added decorative runes or gold. No watermark. One complete finished MAIN MENU screen, not a comparison or contact sheet.

Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup. Edit this existing ORIGINAL gameplay UI mockup with only these improvements. KEEP the same 16:9 screen, charcoal/ivory/rust red paper aesthetic, exact readable existing HUD fields and values, overhead courtyard, roughly 12 hostile ERASER enemies, and compact minimap. Make scene read more like actual playable 2D game and less like elaborate concept illustration. Simplify environmental details by about 65%: big low-contrast dark graphite shapes, sparse ballpoint outlines, fewer stones/hatching/stains; perimeter architecture stays irregular, central arena open and darker than characters. Reduce hero BODY to about 7% of image height (currently too big), and proportionately reduce the held brush and attack arc, leaving more open space around player. Keep glasses-wearing collector identity but use very few powerful lines: compact solid dark hair with 3 blunt tufts, simple glasses and narrowed eyes, stern mouth, plain angular dark coat and large flat boots, no detailed folds or anime hair strands. Original economical 2D fighter with a confident braced stance, not a child mascot. Erasers likewise clear two-tone rectangular bodies, narrow angry eyes and short legs, no excessive chips or hatching; reduce each enemy body scale by ~20% so they feel like sprites. Keep the ORIGINAL HUD text EXACTLY and unchanged including "生命 640 / 800", "Lv. 7", "基础画笔 8 / 12", "得分 350 · 金币 42 · 评级 180", "G 神笔 32 / 45"; don't add any stats or hotbar. Retain dry, tactile linework but less bright paint splatter. Keep sparse real brush traces on ground readable. No large black/white pure fields, no neon, no gold, no 3D, no watermark. Output one complete gameplay screen, not a before-after.
